title: Common primitives
description: Shared scalar contracts (schema_version 1). Identifiers are opaque: clients compare them, never parse them.

SchemaVersion.title: SchemaVersion
SchemaVersion.description: Wire compatibility version. Breaking changes require a new value and a docs/contracts change record.

RequestId.title: RequestId
RequestId.description: Correlates one HTTP request across host, context-service and logs.

EventId.title: EventId
EventId.description: Unique per event. The SSE `id:` line carries the run-scoped sequence, not this value.

IdempotencyKey.title: IdempotencyKey
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key; the same key with the same body returns the first result.

InputDigest.title: InputDigest
InputDigest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of a tool input, prefixed with the algorithm.

RelativePath.title: RelativePath
RelativePath.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path. Server absolute paths never leave the server.

OpaqueCursor.title: OpaqueCursor
OpaqueCursor.description: Server-issued cursor bound to scope, revision and operation. Clients pass it back unchanged.

IndexRevision.title: IndexRevision
IndexRevision.description: Monotonic symbol index revision of one workspace (3.3).

PointerUri.title: PointerUri
PointerUri.description: Boundary reference to a 4.2-owned pointer. Opaque handle; format follows docs/architecture/POINTER_DESIGN.md.

ShortText.title: ShortText
ShortText.description: User-visible bounded text such as a summary or message.
